config.defaultProvider.description: Default AI provider used by editor commands.
config.includeWorkspace.description: Attach workspace metadata to assistant requests.

config.includeDiagnostics.description: Attach diagnostics for the active file to assistant requests.
config.maxFileChars.description: Maximum characters of active-file context attached to assistant requests.

config.home.visibleAgentIds.description: Installed CLI agents shown on the Agents GUI home header. Leave empty to show all installed agents.
config.home.agentOrder.description: Display order for installed CLI agents in the Agents GUI home header.
config.apiProviders.customProviders.desc: Custom API providers that can be used by multiple CLI agents. API keys can be synced through VS Code settings or referenced by environment variable name.
config.apiProviders.customProviders.apiK: Optional API key value stored in VS Code settings so Settings Sync can copy it across signed-in machines.
config.apiProviders.defaultProviderId.de: Global default custom API provider ID.
config.apiProviders.agentProviderByCliId: Per-agent custom API provider overrides. Use inherit to follow the global default.
config.commitMessage.provider.descriptio: AI provider used for Git commit message generation. Default follows Agents GUI: Default Provider.
config.commitMessage.language.descriptio: Language used for AI generated Git commit messages. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
config.commitMessage.maxDiffChars.descri: Maximum staged diff characters attached when generating a Git commit message.
